skill.name: set-up-magento-meta-advanced-matching
skill.description: Set up and verify Meta Advanced Matching for Magento through Product Metrics. Check consent and test order delivery before relying on match quality in Meta Events Manager.
skill.summary: Verify that consented Magento purchase events reach Meta with matching data.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags are Markdown, expected vendor links, or ordinary setup checks. Confirmed risks involve authenticated API calls, order access, and installation from external sources. The workflow also asks for a Meta credential, can expand into live tracking setup, and can use live web content as instructions.

remediation.issue: Meta access token requested by the assistant
remediation.suggestion: Remove the credential exception and require entry in the authenticated Product Metrics app. If a token entered chat, revoke and replace it.

remediation.issue: Live tracking setup can exceed the request
remediation.suggestion: Stop when a prerequisite is missing. Explain the data sent and confirm the store view and Meta destination before any write or activation.

remediation.issue: Live documentation can replace bundled instructions
remediation.suggestion: Use reviewed local references or an immutable copy. Treat fetched text as reference data and require approval for network or configuration changes it suggests.

remediation.issue: Authenticated operations expose more access than verification needs
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist read-only setup checks. Confirm the order scope and use a known test order ID without retrieving margins or unrelated orders.
Require developer approval, verify the publisher and artifact integrity, and pin the installer and source revision. Review Composer dependency changes before production deployment.

content.user_title: Set Up Meta Advanced Matching for Magento
content.value_statement: Magento purchases can reach Meta without enough customer data to match them to ads. This skill guides consent setup and verifies delivery with a paid test order.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status for the selected store view and linked property.
Confirm the Meta pixel is connected and enabled before testing.
Identify supported consent banners and explain when a custom integration is needed.
Distinguish a connection test event from a paid Magento test order.
Explain which matching fields are hashed and which browser fields require additional consent.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, an active Magento connection, and an existing Meta Conversions API destination.
A developer installs the Magento module and maintains cron. The merchant handles steps in Magento Admin and Meta Events Manager.
Meta rejects events older than seven days. Later refunds or cancellations do not update events already sent.
A successful test does not guarantee a higher Event Match Quality score. This workflow does not change campaign bidding.

use_cases.title: Verify a store before launch
use_cases.description: Confirm the linked store view, active Meta pixel, and consent banner before placing a paid test order.

use_cases.title: Investigate low Event Match Quality
use_cases.description: Check whether paid orders reach Meta and whether available customer fields are sent with consent.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a missing test order
use_cases.description: Check Magento configuration revisions, cron, and consent to identify why a known test order did not arrive.

prompt_templates.title: Check the prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List the prerequisites for Meta Advanced Matching in my Magento store. Tell me what I can verify in the app without sharing credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Review consent settings
prompt_templates.prompt: My Magento store uses Cookiebot. Show me how to verify the Product Metrics consent setting and explain what happens if a shopper declines.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a purchase test
prompt_templates.prompt: Give me a test plan for one paid Magento test order. Separate the Meta connection test from order delivery, and tell me what counts as success.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate missing matching data
prompt_templates.scenario: Low Event Match Quality after setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me diagnose low Event Match Quality for one Magento store view. Use read-only checks and a known test order. Do not change settings or request my token.

output_examples.input: The Meta test event was accepted. Does that verify matching for paid orders?
output_examples.output: No. It confirms that the destination accepts test events. Place a paid order in payment test mode, then check the linked property after Magento cron runs.

output_examples.input: Only the Magento cookie restriction notice is active. Will Meta receive my purchase event?
output_examples.output: No. The Magento notice does not grant ad user data consent. Connect a supported banner or ask your developer to pass the visitor's choices.

best_practices: Confirm the store view, linked property, and Meta pixel before testing.
Enter credentials in the authenticated app and use payment test mode with test customer data.
Verify both consent granted and consent denied behavior before relying on production reporting.
anti_patterns: Treating an accepted connection test as proof of matching on purchases.
Posting access tokens or private Magento configuration files in chat.
Assuming that the Magento cookie restriction notice grants marketing consent.

faq.question: Is there a separate Advanced Matching switch?
faq.answer: No. Once the destination is saved, Product Metrics includes available matching data on events when the visitor grants ad user data consent.

faq.question: Can it match guest orders?
faq.answer: Yes. With consent, it can send the hashed guest email and available address fields from the order.

faq.question: Is every matching field hashed?
faq.answer: No. Contact identifiers are hashed, but Meta receives the IP address and user agent without hashing. Meta cookie IDs also require ad storage consent.

faq.question: Can I keep my browser Meta pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. Meta counts the event once when both sources send the same event name and ID within 48 hours.

faq.question: Which consent banners work without custom code?
faq.answer: Product Metrics supports OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, and Osano. Other banners need developer integration.

faq.question: Can it import old orders or apply refunds?
faq.answer: No. It does not import past orders, and refunds do not revise events that Meta has already received.
